about: Prompt-level cases from a person's verdicts and notes on 122 pictures (evals/story-pictures.json: human, human_note; evals/paired-verdicts.json: per version human, human_note, way). A failing case is a fault the person noted (or, for a picture judged partly or wrong without a note, the fault the blind judge or the picture judge named: fault_from), with expectations on the moment's preparation (its rebuilt prompt, images and floor plan) that, met, would have prevented it; a passing case is a moment the person called right, with what must stay true of it. code expectations name a check in evals/prompt-cases.ts (CHECKS); ask expectations are yes-or-no questions Jev answers about the prompt text, and every fault whose faulty fact can be written has one that must be answered no about it. verdicts are the person's on every drawing of the moment (story: drawn on the night; mockup, edit, free: the paired versions, which differ only in image 1); seen_in, the drawings the fault was seen in. The rule: a fault seen only in the edit is the first image's (reference_conflict); a fault seen in one drawing only while another with the same image 1 (for the free version, the same everything else) was right is a hypothesis. Kept out of the pass rates, and shown: model_only (the image model's alone), set_aside (the note disagrees with the dream as told), hypothesis (the pictures do not settle the cause). needs_model_step: counted, and shown apart, because what would meet it is written nowhere in the saved dream and only a model making it again (a floor plan, a reading of what lasts) can supply it. step: the step of HARNESS_PLAN.md whose eval it is. Ids in args are the saved dream's own (p1 is the dreamer in every one of these dreams). unused: notes that gave no case, and why.
